title: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.27909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) integrate terrestrial and aerial platforms to provide ubiquitous communication, sensing, and localization services for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. However, dynamic air-ground and air-air channels, abrupt blockages, and heterogeneous interference hinder the realization of this goal. translated_title: 基于多智能体强化学习的低空流体天线网络
translated_abstract: 低空无线网络（LAWNs）融合地面与空中平台，为无人机（UAV）和电动垂直起降飞行器（eVTOL）提供无处不在的通信、感知和定位服务。然而，动态的空-地和空-空信道、突发的遮挡以及异构干扰阻碍了这一目标的实现。尽管如此，流体天线（FA）作为一种前沿的多输入多输出（MIMO）技术，通过重新配置天线位置来释放额外的空间自由度，从而克服这些挑战。在本文中，为了推动低空流体天线网络的落地实现，我们研究了利用多智能体强化学习（MARL）为低空流体天线网络实现快速且高性能的流体天线重构。具体而言，我们提出了一种电磁数字孪生（EM-DT）辅助的MARL框架。为了填补仿真到现实的差距，我们引入了一种双阶段……
tldr: 本文提出一种电磁数字孪生辅助的多智能体强化学习框架，实现低空流体天线网络的快速高性能天线重构，以应对动态信道、突发遮挡和异构干扰的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an electromagnetic digital twin-assisted multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve fast and high-performance fluid antenna reconfiguration in low-altitude fluid antenna networks, tackling challenges of dynamic channels, abrupt blockages, and heterogeneous interference.
